data.message: Fisher01–25: I commit to 18 tons; join individually, not as an all-or-nothing deal. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k, stock left=250−8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). Even all 18 leaves 50, but recovery to 500 isn't guaranteed; long-run gains aren't assured. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches require recalculation. Each of you: what exact catch do you intend, and is it conditional on others?
